dissonance: Clicking Play Again (or pressing Space) instantly resets the ball, paddles and score in place, with no flash and no reload — the browser tab, URL, sign-in session and any in-session preferences stay exactly as they were. Take this away and Play Again would need a full page reload to start a fresh match, showing a brief blank flash and re-running page load work (auth check, asset fetch) every time, and any in-session preference could be lost in the process.

metrics.name: play_again_click
metrics.description: Counts how often players click the Play Again button (or press Space) after the game-over screen is shown, divided by how many times the game-over screen was shown.

metrics.name: page_reload
metrics.description: Counts full browser page reloads that occur after a game-over screen is shown, which should stay near zero since restart should happen without reloading.
